reason: Victoria TX moved its single-member council districts to the May uniform election date; BallotReady still projects them forward on November. The city names Saturday May 1, 2027 for Districts 1-4 (victoriatx.gov/198/Elections), and BallotReady's own Victoria mayor and super-district races already sit on the May date. Filing window is the statutory May window, the 108th through 78th day before election day (Tex. Elec. Code 143.007(c)).
